s01293.summary: Arthur finds Imelda waiting in the station hall after years away
Imelda reproaches Arthur for being four years late; he offers excuses
Winifred rises and walks away down the hall without looking back
Imelda gives Arthur his father's hat and straightens it on him

s00654.summary: Tandi drives the cash-filled hearse while the crew cleans up in back
Mireille's humming frays Izzy's nerves as Laurence orders silence
Tandi has them watch steady headlights following far behind
Tandi pulls over and kills the engine as the headlights approach
A taxi passes; Mireille calls it the end of fear, Izzy doubts

s02361.summary: Erlandel slips into Brunhilde's tollhouse, pays, and trades quiet greetings
Sprigget whispers that Ulfric hasn't spoken since the flood; Ulfric bristles
Brunhilde serves tea, nudging a cup to Ulfric, who takes it
Sprigget steals a coin while everyone pretends not to notice

s02479.summary: Sal, Duke and Barney wait in the closed alley with nervous Moses
Sal and Duke needle sweaty Moses, who wants to leave without paying
Moses opens the bag to reveal folded newspaper instead of cash
Sal stands and Duke steps behind Moses, who drops the bag

s00782.summary: Lucia and Greta fight to stabilize Abel in the ice-rink hospital
Rafi bursts in with Kofi, who recognizes his brother Abel
Kofi runs to Abel, toppling Greta's tray and sending Lucia sprawling
Abel flatlines and Lucia shocks him back to a heartbeat
Lucia's hands shake as Rafi reassures Kofi his brother is okay
Lucia gruffly inspects Kofi's bad bandage as Abel wakes

s00765.summary: Between rounds, Mel coaches battered Priss through the earpiece from Tulsa
Priss rises, weaves past jabs, and slips her opponent's hook
Priss lands the counter, drops her opponent, and Mel cheers

s00952.summary: Constance and Georgiana whisper about the Duchess watching them
The Duchess overhears and skewers their flattery about her pearls and debts
The Duchess orders both young women to dance and smile

s00148.summary: The masked man works the gondola hatch while Imelda shushes him
The hatch opens and he climbs up, joking out of habit
The wheel lurches and Imelda points out Dmitri's slipped mask
In sync, they grin, clip the rope, and Dmitri steps out

s01728.summary: Stranded on the salt flat, Dev finds the fuel line cracked
Pilar tries to settle Anneliese, who reassures anxious Mox with exact mileage
Jorund hedges about the satellite phone until Dev presses him
Jorund calls rescue and Dispatch promises a team by ten
Dispatch reports a triggered beacon and two vehicles at their coordinates
Dev asks about spare keys as a running truck appears on the horizon
Jorund realizes Mox's betrayal and orders his hands up

s00708.summary: Quentin tells his gathered guests they are snowed in for days
Harlan and Odette press Quentin about the reunion and the late guest
Quentin names the guest as Teddy Marsh, whom Basil says died
The door rattles; Ngozi orders Basil to check and he refuses
Harlan recoils from the rattling latch as Quentin calmly announces the arrival

s01631.summary: Okafor and Lindgren trade barbs over the client's signature before the judge
The radiator interrupts and Tsukamoto asks counsel to speak in turn
Okafor submits Exhibit nine, a notarized signature dated the fourth
Lindgren points out the signature is actually Okafor's own
Asked to explain, Okafor laughs and claims he grabbed the wrong folder

s00552.summary: Agnes fights the vending machine as Walter shuffles in to advise
Sharing pretzels, they trade news of spouses in rooms 412 and 414
Agnes admits she needs looking after; Walter jokes about his pole
Agnes gently tells Walter she is his wife and he called her Delia
Walter's confusion breaks as he realizes Agnes is his wife
Agnes holds his hand and buys more pretzels before taking him back

s01914.summary: Zephyra announces the ship's tally is forty crowns short
The crew bicker over who ate the last of the pie
Pip and Gunnar collide over a lantern; Zephyra calmly issues orders
Dame Oswytha bursts into the galley and demands a word
Oswytha delivers a royal-sealed tube that the crew eyes with dread
The scroll is a pardon, and Pip learns they always smuggled
Oswytha reveals the Crown wants to hire them for new smuggling
Zephyra laughs and invites Oswytha to join them for dinner

s01802.summary: Ruth and Lorelei sit in strained silence over refilled coffee
A soaked stranger arrives, addresses Ruth, and sits beside Lorelei
The man pushes Ruth to tell Lorelei the truth about their father
The man reveals he is Bernard, their father's secret son
Ruth tearfully admits she always meant to tell Lorelei
Lorelei stands, pulls away from Ruth, and orders both to sit

s00957.summary: Leonidas demands the Stranger's name; he claims to have none
The Stranger recognizes Sally and reveals he is her brother Ephraim
Sally refuses to believe him as Leonidas orders her to stand down

s01778.summary: In the silo, Delphine orders everyone still as a stranger waits
Enrico tells frightened Max to lower the crowbar; Max refuses
The Stranger steps into the light and names himself Anselm
In darkness Anselm closes on Max while the grain stirs; Delphine orders retreat
Max swings, Anselm catches the bar, and the wheat rises

s01242.summary: A stranger rides up to Jeremiah's porch and asks for water
The stranger praises the well and Jeremiah invites him to sit
The stranger names himself Jedediah Pike, Jeremiah's runaway son
They recall the day Jedediah ran off with a horse
Jeremiah sets down the carving and gruffly offers his son beans
Jeremiah hides his tears going inside; Jedediah finishes his father's carving

s01499.summary: Two couples trade wary glances as the revolving restaurant turns
Theodore slips Solange a note, which she reads without expression
Sabine seizes Halvard's wrist as Dimitri reaches for his jacket
Solange smiles and says the elevator has stopped; the lights die

s01673.summary: In the derelict rink, Tobias kneels at the hack as the radio announces the final
Tobias throws a crooked stone and blames the ice when Mireille notices
Mireille tells Tobias the team filled her spot; he deflects
A truck horn sounds; Mireille lays down her broom and asks him to come
Tobias sets the stone aside and lingers as she goes

s02055.summary: Holly confronts Jubilee about the rumor that she quit band
Jubilee explains she's tired of being second chair to Ingrid
Holly challenges her despair; Jubilee says being good doesn't matter
Holly admits he listens to her practice every Tuesday through the wall
Holly's mom calls and he fends off her questions about Jubilee
Holly tells Jubilee everyone knows she's good and urges her to play
Jubilee opens her case and Holly counts her in on the piano

s00111.summary: In the stalled cage, Valerian urges wary Dorothea to press the red button
Dorothea questions why he needs it stopped; he says to talk
Dorothea presses the alarm, and the cage shrieks and shudders
Valerian lunges; they grapple, the lever snaps, and the cage drops
Gasping, Dorothea demands he talk; Valerian warns she won't like it
Valerian admits he sold the whole shipment to her brother
Dorothea coldly welcomes the news and drives the elevator up to her brother

s00678.summary: Spud demands Loretta drop the cash; she mocks his rented shoes
Dutch asks Pearl to pick a side; she sides with Lane 14
Spud's thundering ball scatters pins and Gideon; Minnow yells strike

s01566.summary: On the glass desert, the Warden questions why Willa has come
Willa raises her lantern and something stirs beneath the sand
Willa says the lantern was her buried grandmother's; the Warden refuses the dead
The Warden's lens shows Willa's grandmother among spinning figures
Willa demands her release; the Warden names the Silent Court
Willa steps forward, cracking the glass, and the Warden retreats
The Warden asks Willa's spring in exchange for one hour
Willa weighs the price and both seal the bargain with yes
A stair opens; Willa descends as the Warden watches her light vanish

s02015.summary: Clementine questions Prudence about the book missing from the locked cabinet
Clementine studies the shelf and probes Prudence's service and the book's value
Clementine suggests Prudence could have taken it; Prudence coolly agrees
Prudence reveals she expected her and the book was never there
Clementine finds the hidden slot and learns the shelf is a decoy
They share a smile and Prudence reveals the book is behind the flour tin

s00865.summary: Mina rushes the morning routine while Rowan sits frozen with his backpack
Mina pushes Rowan about shoes and he pulls away from her touch
Gus tells Mina to let the boy be; he isn't ready
Mina softens and gently asks if it's the test; Rowan shakes his head
Gus sits beside Rowan and offers to walk him in
Mina hands over the lunch and Rowan finally lets her kiss him
